SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

6. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

8. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

11. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   B. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   D. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
